The family value

Good Training for Them. A Better Routine for You.

Kids train. Families get a steady after-school routine.

For your child

Movement, problem solving, friends, and the ability to keep working when the answer changes.

For your family

Predictable reservations, clear feedback, make-up class by text, and a coach who knows the student.

Progress you can notice

You Won’t Have to Guess Whether They’re Progressing.

Attention

Returns to the task after distraction without repeated prompting.

Partner care

Stops immediately when a partner taps.

Problem solving

Tries another useful solution when the first one fails.

Communication

Tells the coach when something is confusing or uncomfortable.
